desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to reachability in the P/Q cycles containing X plus a shortest common supersequence of two directed paths.
Implement input parsing and inverse permutations.
Mark the P-cycle and Q-cycle containing X and reject if any A_i=1 is outside the P-cycle or any B_i=1 is outside the Q-cycle.
Compute distances from X along inverse P/Q, find farthest initial red/blue boxes, and construct forward paths R and B from farthest to X excluding X; handle empty paths.
Compute LCS length of R and B by mapping R positions and running strict LIS over B's mapped positions.
Output len(R)+len(B)-LCS, and check edge cases: no balls, balls only at X, one empty path, and conflicting orders requiring repeated boxes.
